caseNameFull: J. H. CRAIN AND R. E. LEE WILSON, JR., TRUSTEES OF LEE WILSON AND COMPANY, A BUSINESS TRUST v. United States

opinions.text:
Agricultural Adjustment Act; jurisdiction; discretion of Secretary of Agriculture in determination of facts. Petitions dismissed.

Plaintiffs’ petitions for writs of certiorari denied, by the Supreme Court March 13,1950.
